detect-names-and-quotes-no-score:
This reads as strongly machine-made. Almost every clause is a recognisable default rather than a specific claim.

- "In today's fast-paced digital landscape" — banned opener, throat-clearing that fits any product in any industry.
- "isn't just a tool - it's a partner" — not-X-but-Y staging, plus an em dash used as a connector.
- "It stands as a testament to" — inflated significance and avoids the plain verb (B1/B7); says nothing checkable.
- "pivotal commitment" — inflation word, and "pivotal" specifically is on the AI-vocabulary list.
- "seamless, vibrant collaboration" — two more AI/sales-vocabulary words stacked together, doing no descriptive work.
- "empowering teams to unlock their full potential" — vague declarative closer; would survive being pasted into any company's marketing copy unchanged.

What's missing is what a person writes: no specific feature, no concrete example of what the platform does, no particular reader in mind. Nothing here could be quoted back to prove a fact about the product — it's all staging and borrowed weight, with no content underneath to check.

My name is Dan and I run ScentVerdict, a fragrance review site that I started last year after getting frustrated with how hard it was to find honest reviews of niche perfumes.

Each review is based on at least two weeks of wear, and we score longevity, projection and value separately, because a single star rating hides too much. Over the last twelve months we have published 2,400 reviews, and our readers tell us the separate scores are the reason they come back.

I have been following your house for a while and I think your approach to small-batch releases is exactly the kind of story our readers care about. I would love to review your autumn collection, and I would be happy to share our methodology in more detail, including how we handle samples, how we disclose free products, and how we make sure the review is independent of any commercial relationship.

We also run a monthly newsletter that goes to our most engaged readers, and we have a small but growing presence on Instagram and TikTok, where short wear-test videos have done particularly well.

Please do get in touch if this sounds interesting. I would be delighted to set up a call at a time that suits you.

Kind regards,
Dan
